LanguageData.SSC_PnaMaintenance_Unavailable: PNA maintenance cannot be configured right now.
LanguageData.SSC_PnaMaintenance_Tooltip: After finishing the current task, consume raw PNA before taking another ordinary job until activation reaches the selected stage. Takes one unit at a time and only applies to a sex slave with a valid chain.\nThe first stage is replenished once activation disappears; a single dose may exceed the target stage. This setting belongs to the current chain and is lost when that chain is removed. Vanilla scheduled drug use remains independent.
